verses.en: And it came to pass, that after we were gotten from them, and had launched, we came with a straight course unto Coos, and the day following unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:
verses.pt: E assim aconteceu que, separando-nos deles, navegamos e, correndo em direitura, chegamos a Cós, e no dia seguinte a Rodes, e dali a Pátara.
verses.en_web: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
verses.en_bbe: And after parting from them, we put out to sea and came straight to Cos, and the day after to Rhodes, and from there to Patara:

verses.en: And finding a ship sailing over unto Phenicia, we went aboard, and set forth.
verses.pt: Achando um navio que seguia para a Fenícia, embarcamos e partimos.
verses.en_web: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard, and set sail.
verses.en_bbe: And as there was a ship going to Phoenicia, we went in it.

verses.en: Now when we had discovered Cyprus, we left it on the left hand, and sailed into Syria, and landed at Tyre: for there the ship was to unlade her burden.
verses.pt: E quando avistamos Chipre, deixando-a á esquerda, navegamos para a Síria e chegamos a Tiro, pois o navio havia de ser descarregado ali.
verses.en_web: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria, and landed at Tyre, for there the ship was to unload her cargo.
verses.en_bbe: And when we had come in view of Cyprus, going past it on our left, we went on to Syria, and came to land at Tyre: for there the goods which were in the ship had to be taken out.

verses.en: And finding disciples, we tarried there seven days: who said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Havendo achado os discípulos, demoramo-nos ali sete dias; e eles pelo Espírito diziam a Paulo que não subisse a Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And meeting the disciples we were there for seven days: and they gave Paul orders through the Spirit not to go up to Jerusalem.

verses.en: And when we had accomplished those days, we departed and went our way; and they all brought us on our way, with wives and children, till we were out of the city: and we kneeled down on the shore, and prayed.
verses.pt: Depois de passarmos ali aqueles dias, saímos e seguimos a nossa viagem, acompanhando-nos todos, com suas mulheres e filhos, até fora da cidade; e, postos de joelhos na praia, oramos,
verses.en_web: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.
verses.en_bbe: And when these days came to an end, we went on our journey; and they all, with their wives and children, came with us on our way till we were out of the town: and after going on our knees in prayer by the sea,

verses.en: And when we had taken our leave one of another, we took ship; and they returned home again.
verses.pt: e despedindo-nos uns dos outros, embarcamos, e eles voltaram para casa.
verses.en_web: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.
verses.en_bbe: We said our last words to one another, and got into the ship, and they went back to their houses.

verses.en: And when we had finished our course from Tyre, we came to Ptolemais, and saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.
verses.pt: Concluída a nossa viagem de Tiro, chegamos a Ptolemaida; e, havendo saudado os irmãos, passamos um dia com eles.
verses.en_web: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers, and stayed with them one day.
verses.en_bbe: And journeying by ship from Tyre we came to Ptolemais; and there we had talk with the brothers and were with them for one day.

verses.en: And the next day we that were of Paul’s company departed, and came unto Caesarea: and we entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, which was one of the seven; and abode with him.
verses.pt: Partindo no dia seguinte, fomos a Cesaréia; e entrando em casa de Felipe, o evangelista, que era um dos sete, ficamos com ele.
verses.en_web: On the next day, we, who were Paul’s companions, departed, and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
verses.en_bbe: And on the day after, we went away and came to Caesarea, where we were guests in the house of Philip, the preacher, who was one of the seven.

verses.en: And the same man had four daughters, virgins, which did prophesy.
verses.pt: Tinha este quatro filhas virgens que profetizavam.
verses.en_web: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
verses.en_bbe: And he had four daughters, virgins, who were prophets.

verses.en: And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judaea a certain prophet, named Agabus.
verses.pt: Demorando-nos ali por muitos dias, desceu da Judéia um profeta, de nome Ágabo;
verses.en_web: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
verses.en_bbe: And while we were waiting there for some days, a certain prophet, named Agabus, came down from Judaea.

verses.en: And when he was come unto us, he took Paul’s girdle, and bound his own hands and feet, and said, Thus saith the Holy Ghost, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.
verses.pt: e vindo ter conosco, tomou a cinta de Paulo e, ligando os seus próprios pés e mãos, disse: Isto diz o Espírito Santo: Assim os judeus ligarão em Jerusalém o homem a quem pertence esta cinta, e o entregarão nas mãos dos gentios.
verses.en_web: Coming to us, and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “Thus says the Holy Spirit: ‘So will the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”
verses.en_bbe: And he came to us, and took the band of Paul's clothing, and putting it round his feet and hands, said, The Holy Spirit says these words, So will the Jews do to the man who is the owner of this band, and they will give him up into the hands of the Gentiles.

verses.en: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Quando ouvimos isto, rogamos-lhe, tanto nós como os daquele lugar, que não subisse a Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: When we heard these things, both we and they of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And hearing these things, we and those who were living in that place made request to him not to go to Jerusalem.

verses.en: Then Paul answered, What mean ye to weep and to break mine heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.pt: Então Paulo resppondeu: Que fazeis chorando e magoando-me o coração? Porque eu estou pronto não só a ser ligado, mas ainda a morrer em Jerusalém pelo nome do Senhor Jesus.
verses.en_web: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
verses.en_bbe: Then Paul said, What are you doing, weeping and wounding my heart? for I am ready, not only to be a prisoner, but to be put to death at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

verses.en: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.
verses.pt: E, como não se deixasse persuadir, dissemos: Faça-se a vontade do Senhor; e calamo-nos.
verses.en_web: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”
verses.en_bbe: And as he might not be moved we did no more, saying, Let the purpose of God be done.

verses.en: And after those days we took up our carriages, and went up to Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Depois destes dias, havendo feito os preparativos, fomos subindo a Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: And after these days we got ready and went up to Jerusalem.

verses.en: There went with us also certain of the disciples of Caesarea, and brought with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an old disciple, with whom we should lodge.
verses.pt: E foram também conosco alguns discípulos de Cesaréia, levando consigo um certo Mnáson, cíprio, discípulo antigo, com quem nos havíamos de hospedar.
verses.en_web: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
verses.en_bbe: And some of the disciples from Caesarea went with us, taking a certain Mnason of Cyprus, one of the early disciples, in whose house we were to be living.

verses.en: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.
verses.pt: E chegando nós a Jerusalém, os irmãos nos receberam alegremente.
verses.en_web: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
verses.en_bbe: And when we came to Jerusalem, the brothers were pleased to see us.

verses.en: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.
verses.pt: No dia seguinte Paulo foi em nossa companhia ter com Tiago, e compareceram todos os anciãos.
verses.en_web: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.
verses.en_bbe: And on the day after, Paul went with us to James, and all the rulers of the church were present.

verses.en: And when he had saluted them, he declared particularly what things God had wrought among the Gentiles by his ministry.
verses.pt: E, havendo-os saudado, contou-lhes uma por uma as coisas que por seu ministério Deus fizera entre os gentios.
verses.en_web: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.
verses.en_bbe: And when he had said how glad he was to see them, he gave them a detailed account of the things which God had done through his work among the Gentiles.

verses.en: And when they heard it, they glorified the Lord, and said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands of Jews there are which believe; and they are all zealous of the law:
verses.pt: Ouvindo eles isto, glorificaram a Deus, e disseram-lhe: Bem vês, irmãos, quantos milhares há entre os judeus que têm crido, e todos são zelosos da lei; gregos, ouviram a palavra do
verses.en_web: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.
verses.en_bbe: And hearing it, they gave praise to God; and they said to him, You see, brother, what thousands there are among the Jews, who have the faith; and they all have a great respect for the law:

verses.en: And they are informed of thee, that thou teachest all the Jews which are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, saying that they ought not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.
verses.pt: e têm sido informados a teu respeito que ensinas todos os judeus que estão entre os gentios a se apartarem de Moisés, dizendo que não circuncidem seus filhos, nem andem segundo os costumes da lei.
verses.en_web: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children neither to walk after the customs.
verses.en_bbe: And they have had news of you, how you have been teaching all the Jews among the Gentiles to give up the law of Moses, and not to give circumcision to their children, and not to keep the old rules.

verses.en: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.
verses.pt: Que se há de fazer, pois? Certamente saberão que és chegado.
verses.en_web: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.
verses.en_bbe: What then is the position? They will certainly get news that you have come.

verses.en: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;
verses.pt: Faze, pois, o que te vamos dizer: Temos quatro homens que fizeram voto;
verses.en_web: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.
verses.en_bbe: Do this, then, which we say to you: We have four men who have taken an oath;

verses.en: Them take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges with them, that they may shave their heads: and all may know that those things, whereof they were informed concerning thee, are nothing; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, and keepest the law.
verses.pt: toma estes contigo, e santifica-te com eles, e faze por eles as despesas para que rapem a cabeça; e saberão todos que é falso aquilo de que têm sido informados a teu respeito, mas que também tu mesmo andas corretamente, guardando a lei.
verses.en_web: Take them, and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.
verses.en_bbe: Go with these, and make yourself clean with them, and make the necessary payments for them, so that they may be free from their oath: and everyone will see that the statements made about you are not true, but that you put yourself under rule, and keep the law.

verses.en: As touching the Gentiles which believe, we have written and concluded that they observe no such thing, save only that they keep themselves from things offered to idols, and from blood, and from strangled, and from fornication.
verses.pt: Todavia, quanto aos gentios que têm crido já escrevemos, dando o parecer que se abstenham do que é sacrificado a os ídolos, do sangue, do sufocado e da prostituição.
verses.en_web: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”
verses.en_bbe: But as to the Gentiles who have the faith, we sent a letter, giving our decision that they were to keep themselves from offerings made to false gods, and from blood, and from the flesh of animals put to death in ways against the law, and from the evil desires of the body.

verses.en: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of purification, until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.
verses.pt: Então Paulo, no dia seguinte, tomando consigo aqueles homens, purificou-se com eles e entrou no templo, notificando o cumprimento dos dias da purificação, quando seria feita a favor de cada um deles a respectiva oferta.
verses.en_web: Then Paul took the men, and the next day, purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.
verses.en_bbe: Then Paul took the men, and on the day after, making himself clean with them, he went into the Temple, giving out the statement that the days necessary for making them clean were complete, till the offering was made for every one of them.

verses.en: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews which were of Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the people, and laid hands on him,
verses.pt: Mas quando os sete dias estavam quase a terminar, os judeus da Ásia, tendo-o visto no templo, alvoroçaram todo o povo e agarraram-no,
verses.en_web: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,
verses.en_bbe: And when the seven days were almost ended, the Jews from Asia, seeing him in the Temple, got the people together and put their hands on him,

verses.en: Crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man, that teacheth all men every where against the people, and the law, and this place: and further brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath polluted this holy place.
verses.pt: clamando: Varões israelitas, acudi; este é o homem que por toda parte ensina a todos contra o povo, contra a lei, e contra este lugar; e ainda, além disso, introduziu gregos no templo, e tem profanado este santo lugar.
verses.en_web: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple, and has defiled this holy place!”
verses.en_bbe: Crying out, Men of Israel, come to our help: this is the man who is teaching all men everywhere against the people and the law and this place: and in addition, he has taken Greeks into the Temple, and made this holy place unclean.

verses.en: (For they had seen before with him in the city Trophimus an Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.)
verses.pt: Porque tinham visto com ele na cidade a Trófimo de Éfeso, e pensavam que Paulo o introduzira no templo.
verses.en_web: For they had seen Trophimus, the Ephesian, with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
verses.en_bbe: For they had seen him before in the town with Trophimus of Ephesus, and had the idea that Paul had taken him with him into the Temple.

verses.en: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together: and they took Paul, and drew him out of the temple: and forthwith the doors were shut.
verses.pt: Alvoroçou-se toda a cidade, e houve ajuntamento do povo; e agarrando a Paulo, arrastaram-no para fora do templo, e logo as portas se fecharam.
verses.en_web: All the city was moved, and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.
verses.en_bbe: And all the town was moved, and the people came running together and put their hands on Paul, pulling him out of the Temple: and then the doors were shut.

verses.en: And as they went about to kill him, tidings came unto the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
verses.pt: E, procurando eles matá-lo, chegou ao comandante da coorte o aviso de que Jerusalém estava toda em confusão;
verses.en_web: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
verses.en_bbe: And while they were attempting to put him to death, news came to the chief captain of the band that all Jerusalem was out of control.

verses.en: Who immediately took soldiers and centurions, and ran down unto them: and when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, they left beating of Paul.
verses.pt: o qual, tomando logo consigo soldados e centuriões, correu para eles; e quando viram o comandante e os soldados, cessaram de espancar a Paulo.
verses.en_web: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions, and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.
verses.en_bbe: And straight away he took some armed men and went quickly down to them: and the Jews, seeing them, gave no more blows to Paul.

verses.en: Then the chief captain came near, and took him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and demanded who he was, and what he had done.
verses.pt: Então aproximando-se o comandante, prendeu-o e mandou que fosse acorrentado com duas cadeias, e perguntou quem era e o que tinha feito.
verses.en_web: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.
verses.en_bbe: Then the chief captain came near and took him, and gave orders for him to be put in chains, questioning them as to who he was and what he had done.

verses.en: And some cried one thing, some another, among the multitude: and when he could not know the certainty for the tumult, he commanded him to be carried into the castle.
verses.pt: E na multidão uns gritavam de um modo, outros de outro; mas, não podendo por causa do alvoroço saber a verdade, mandou conduzí-lo à fortaleza.
verses.en_web: Some shouted one thing, and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.
verses.en_bbe: And some said one thing and some another, among the people: and as he was not able to get a knowledge of the facts because of the noise, he gave orders for Paul to be taken into the army building.

verses.en: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was, that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the people.
verses.pt: E sucedeu que, chegando às escadas, foi ele carregado pelos soldados por causa da violência da turba.
verses.en_web: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;
verses.en_bbe: And when he came on to the steps, he was lifted up by the armed men, because of the force of the people;

verses.en: For the multitude of the people followed after, crying, Away with him.
verses.pt: Pois a multidão o seguia, gritando: Mata-o!
verses.en_web: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”
verses.en_bbe: For a great mass of people came after them, crying out, Away with him!

verses.en: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?
verses.pt: Quando estava para ser introduzido na fortaleza, disse Paulo ao comandante: É-me permitido dizer-te alguma coisa? Respondeu ele: Sabes o grego?
verses.en_web: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?
verses.en_bbe: And when Paul was about to be taken into the building, he said to the chief captain, May I say something to you? And he said, Have you a knowledge of Greek?

verses.en: Art not thou that Egyptian, which before these days madest an uproar, and leddest out into the wilderness four thousand men that were murderers?
verses.pt: Não és porventura o egípcio que há poucos dias fez uma sedição e levou ao deserto os quatro mil sicários?
verses.en_web: Aren’t you then the Egyptian, who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”
verses.en_bbe: Are you by chance the Egyptian who, before this, got the people worked up against the government and took four thousand men of the Assassins out into the waste land?

verses.en: But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.
verses.pt: Mas Paulo lhe disse: Eu sou judeu, natural de Tarso, cidade não insignificante da Cilícia; rogo-te que me permitas falar ao povo.
verses.en_web: But Paul said, “I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
verses.en_bbe: But Paul said, I am a Jew of Tarsus in Cilicia, which is not an unimportant town: I make a request to you to let me say a word to the people.

verses.en: And when he had given him licence, Paul stood on the stairs, and beckoned with the hand unto the people. And when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew tongue, saying,
verses.pt: E, havendo-lho permitido o comandante, Paulo, em pé na escada, fez sinal ao povo com a mão; e, feito grande silêncio, falou em língua hebraica, dizendo:
verses.en_web: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And when he let him do so, Paul, from the steps, made a sign with his hand to the people, and when they were all quiet, he said to them in the Hebrew language,
